metadata.title: Safety Engineering Foundations — Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for the bounded foundation workflow; synthetic examples are not empirical findings.

primary_sources.name: STPA Handbook (MIT-STAMP-001)
primary_sources.author: Nancy Leveson and John Thomas
primary_sources.scope: Chapter 2: control structures, four UCA categories, constraints and scenarios; relevant passages inspected. Also: system-level constraints, controller constraints, 7-10 hazard rule of thumb, two loss-scenario types (checked 2026-09-23).
primary_sources.verified_via: Primary MIT PDF opened and relevant passages read on 2026-09-17; PDF re-read 2026-09-27: 7-10 hazard rule of thumb, four UCA types, two loss-scenario types, loss/hazard definitions confirmed verbatim

primary_sources.name: CAST Handbook: How to Learn More from Incidents and Accidents
primary_sources.author: Nancy G. Leveson
primary_sources.scope: Chapters 1-4: root-cause/hindsight/blame critique, five CAST parts, per-controller analysis, systemic factors, recommendations and follow-up.
primary_sources.verified_via: MIT PSAS mirror PDF (148 pp) fetched and relevant chapters read 2026-09-23; PDF re-read 2026-09-27: 'analysis method, not an investigation technique', five traps, three follow-up requirements, and 'difficulty of implementation is not an excuse to omit a recommendation' confirmed

primary_sources.name: Safety Cases: How to Justify the Safety of Advanced AI Systems
primary_sources.author: Joshua Clymer, Nick Gabrieli, David Krueger, Thomas Larsen
primary_sources.scope: Four argument categories: total inability, sufficiently strong control measures, trustworthiness despite capability, and (prospective) deference to credible AI advisors.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract read 2026-09-23; full text not read; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: A sketch of an AI control safety case
primary_sources.author: Tomek Korbak, Joshua Clymer, Benjamin Hilton, Buck Shlegeris, Geoffrey Irving
primary_sources.scope: One sketched control case (internal agent, data exfiltration) hinging on elicitation, deployment effectiveness, and conservative extrapolation claims.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract read 2026-09-23; full text not read; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Safety case template for frontier AI: A cyber inability argument
primary_sources.author: Arthur Goemans, Marie Davidsen Buhl, Jonas Schuett, Tomek Korbak, Jessica Wang, Benjamin Hilton, Geoffrey Irving
primary_sources.scope: CAE-structured inability template; presented as a proof of concept.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract read 2026-09-23; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Assurance 2.0: A Manifesto
primary_sources.author: Robin Bloomfield, John Rushby
primary_sources.scope: Explicit identification of defeaters and counterevidence in assurance cases.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract read 2026-09-23; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Goal Structuring Notation Community Standard Version 3 (SCSC-141C)
primary_sources.author: SCSC Assurance Case Working Group
primary_sources.scope: GSN core elements: Goal, Strategy, Solution, Context, Assumption, Justification. Cite the current version from the SCSC site.
primary_sources.verified_via: Version/number/year via web search (bibbase, Wikipedia: May 2021); element names via OntoGSN arXiv:2506.11023; standard text not read; scsc.uk/gsn-standard read 2026-09-27: version 3 still listed as latest

primary_sources.name: Systematic Hazard Analysis for Frontier AI using STPA
primary_sources.author: Simon Mylius
primary_sources.scope: STPA applied to the Korbak et al. control-case scenario; UCAs and loss scenarios.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract read 2026-09-23; full text not read; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Towards Verifiably Safe Tool Use for LLM Agents
primary_sources.author: Aarya Doshi, Yining Hong, Congying Xu, Eunsuk Kang, Alexandros Kapravelos, Christian Kästner
primary_sources.scope: STPA-derived requirements formalized as enforceable data-flow and tool-sequence specifications; capability-labelled MCP. Accepted to ICSE NIER 2026.
primary_sources.verified_via: arXiv API abstract and comment read 2026-09-23; abstract re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Safety-I and Safety-II: The Past and Future of Safety Management
primary_sources.author: Erik Hollnagel
primary_sources.scope: Safety-II perspective and FRAM; moved with the Safety-II section from reliability theory.
primary_sources.verified_via: Carried from foundations-reliability-theory sources (verified 2026-05-17); not re-read 2026-09-23

primary_sources.name: Safety-II and Resilience Engineering in a Nutshell: An Introductory Guide to Their Concepts and Methods
primary_sources.author: Dong-Han Ham
primary_sources.scope: Safety-I/II definitions, same-causes claim, WAI vs WAD, four resilience abilities, FRAM description. Saf Health Work 12(1):10-19. The Safety-II definition quoted in safety-ii-and-stamp.md is Ham's wording, not Hollnagel's.
primary_sources.verified_via: PMC full text fetched 2026-09-23; quoted definitions checked; PMC full text re-read 2026-09-27

primary_sources.name: Engineering a Safer World: Systems Thinking Applied to Safety
primary_sources.author: Nancy G. Leveson
primary_sources.scope: STAMP causality model underlying STPA and CAST.
primary_sources.verified_via: MIT Press title confirmed (reliability sources, 2026-05-17); not re-read

primary_sources.name: ISO 21448:2022 Road vehicles — Safety of the intended functionality
primary_sources.author: ISO
primary_sources.scope: SOTIF: functional insufficiencies (specification and performance) and triggering conditions.
primary_sources.verified_via: Publisher sample PDF (standards.iteh.ai) read 2026-09-23: first edition 2022-06, replaces ISO/PAS 21448:2019; iso.org returned 403

primary_sources.name: ISO/PAS 8800:2024 Road vehicles — Safety and artificial intelligence
primary_sources.author: ISO
primary_sources.scope: Safety lifecycle for AI elements in road vehicles; extends ISO 26262 and ISO 21448.
primary_sources.verified_via: Secondary: UL Solutions blog (2026-09-23 P2 check), released December 2024; iso.org/standard/83303 returned 403

primary_sources.name: UL 4600 Standard for Evaluation of Autonomous Products, Edition 3
primary_sources.author: UL Standards & Engagement
primary_sources.scope: Safety-case-based standard for evaluating autonomous products. Look up the current edition before citing.
primary_sources.verified_via: UL Standards shop page (2026-09-23 P2 check): Edition 3 published 2023-03-17; revision proposals open (latest 2026-08-07); no Edition 4 seen.
